title: QUIZ - 47
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with a Fractional Coefficient
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation where the variable has a fractional coefficient
questions.question: Solve for m: \( 2/3m + 9 = 23/3 \)
questions.explanation: Subtract 9: 2/3m = -4/3. Multiply both sides by 3/2: m = -2.
questions.hint: Isolate the fractional term, then multiply both sides by the reciprocal of the fraction.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with a Fractional Coefficient
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation where the variable has a fractional coefficient
questions.question: Solve for a: \( 2/7a - 14 = -114/7 \)
questions.explanation: Subtract -14: 2/7a = -16/7. Multiply both sides by 7/2: a = -8.
questions.hint: Isolate the fractional term, then multiply both sides by the reciprocal of the fraction.

questions.concept: Combining Fractional Coefficients
questions.learningObjective: Solve an equation by first combining two fractional coefficients of the same variable
questions.question: Solve for m: \( 1/2m + 3/6m = 9 \)
questions.explanation: Combine the fractional coefficients: 1/2 + 3/6 = 1. The equation becomes 1m = 9, so m = 9.
questions.hint: Combine the fractional coefficients of the variable into a single fraction first.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with the Variable Over a Denominator
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation where the variable is divided by a constant
questions.question: Solve for m: \( m/7 - 2 = -5 \)
questions.explanation: Subtract -2 from both sides: m/7 = -3. Multiply both sides by 7: m = -21.
questions.hint: Isolate the term with the variable in the denominator's numerator, then multiply both sides by the denominator.
